source_request: Sunwoo rec action go after recommended next action: prepare a separate P0 production enablement packet
scope: Document-only P0 production enablement packet for future staged production continuous loop enablement

p0_decision.reason: Evidence chain supports preparing a production enablement packet, but does not authorize unattended production activation. Missing GitHub checks remain MISSING_NOT_CI_PASS and production enablement needs separate explicit approval after packet review.

required_pre_activation_acceptance_crite: P0 packet is reviewed and accepted by Sunwoo and, if required, an external human maintainer.
PR evidence chain includes G3 pilot evidence and independent read-only review acceptance.
GitHub checks are either reported passing or explicitly waived in a reviewer-facing record; missing checks are not CI PASS.
A finite P1 cron soak plan is approved with max fire count, expiry, timeout, lock, kill switch, allowed write roots, and rollback path.
Threshold-triggered optimizer remains dry-run/signal-only until a separate budget and optimizer approval is recorded.
Automatic PR loop remains disabled until a separate gated draft-PR-only approval is recorded.
Auto-merge and deploy remain out of scope unless a later explicit approval names them.
Every stage emits JSON/Markdown evidence, side-effect ledger, and fail-closed status.
A human stop switch and operator rollback path are documented and tested before any recurring automation.

allowed_actions: optionally publish packet to PR after separate approval

proposed_stage_plan.purpose: Prepare a future finite cron soak, not run it yet.
Run finite expiring cron soak with approved bounds and no optimizer/auto-PR side effects.
Evaluate threshold-trigger conditions as dry-run signals only.
Prepare candidate-only optimizer plan with explicit budget/model/time caps and no active runtime mutation.
Prepare draft-PR-only automation with path limits, rate limits, labels, and human review requirements.
Only after P1-P4 evidence passes, propose bounded production continuous loop candidate.

p1_minimum_packet_requirements.expiry: required wall-clock TTL and auto-disable/remove behavior
p1_minimum_packet_requirements.timeout: per-fire timeout required, safe default <=1800 seconds
p1_minimum_packet_requirements.kill_switch: repo-local and operator-visible kill switch required
blocked_side_effects: network/model/API budget spend unless separately approved

recommended_next_action: Path-limited commit/push this P0 packet into PR #108 and add a PR body addendum, if Sunwoo approves publication. Activation remains OFF.
